# Datumvista Research Ltd

> Independent market research and fieldwork across the GCC, Africa, Asia and Europe.

Datumvista Research Ltd is a market research and fieldwork firm registered in England & Wales and incorporated in 2024, with a team bringing 12+ years of practitioner experience and operations across 9+ markets. Its teams deliver qualitative research, quantitative surveys, mystery shopping, brand tracking, retail distribution mapping and high-net-worth individual (HNI) research, executed in-house rather than subcontracted. Published studies form a free-to-read public research series.

## Key pages

- [Services](https://datumvista.com/services.html) — the nine research services offered, the survey methodologies used (CAPI, CATI tele calling, PAPI, online, IDIs, focus groups), sample collection, retail audits and answers to common questions.
- [Industries](https://datumvista.com/industries.html) — the 16 sectors covered, from banking, telecoms and healthcare to heavy machinery and government, plus the markets operated in.
- [Published research](https://datumvista.com/research.html) — index of Datumvista's published studies and market intelligence.
- [Bahrain utility cost study](https://datumvista.com/research/bahrain-utility-cost-study-2025/) — public study analysing 75 months of EWA electricity, water and municipality charges for an expatriate household in Manama, 2020–2026 (ref DVR-BH-2025-EWA-001).
- [About](https://datumvista.com/about.html) — company history from 2010 to registration in 2024, working principles and proven capabilities.
- [Contact](https://datumvista.com/contact.html) — how to commission a study; enquiries are answered within one business day and quoted within three working days.

## Notes

- Company: Datumvista Research Ltd, registered in England & Wales.
- Markets: Bahrain, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Oman, Morocco, South Africa, India, Singapore, United Kingdom.
- Coverage of the public study: one anonymised household; findings are indicative, not statistically representative.
- Client work is under NDA, so client names and project specifics are usually not public.
- All pages are plain HTML and readable without JavaScript; see https://datumvista.com/sitemap.xml for the canonical URL list.


## Core Services & Operational Capabilities
- **Quantitative Research Operations:** Face-to-Face (F2F) CAPI/PAPI interviewing, CATI tele calling and telephonic interviews, Central Location Testing (CLT), door-to-door consumer surveys, sample collection, and retail audits.
- **Qualitative Field Logistics:** High-net-worth (HNW) and B2B stakeholder recruitment, focus group organization, in-depth interviews (IDIs), and professional multilingual local moderators.
- **Advanced Field Quality Control:** Driven entirely by native digital field management software (PanelRoster) to provide international clients with 100% transparent audit trails, automated quota tracking, and fraud elimination.

## Geographic Coverage & Execution Markets
Full-scale operational footprint and compliance capabilities in:

## Ideal Strategic Partners
Global market research companies, international insight brokerages, and enterprise consulting agencies looking for a reliable, tech-enabled regional subcontractor to handle offline data collection in the Middle East.
